name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
summary: A Horde Warbringer asks you to bring three Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor. The marks are the proof requested for this call.

sections.title: A Mark Returned
sections.body: You carry the three Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds. The Warbringer asks for these marks, and that is all this call requires.

faq.q: What does the Warbringer ask for?
faq.answer: The Horde Warbringer asks you to bring three Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Where do I bring the marks?
faq.answer: Bring the marks to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
The Warbringer asks for three Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can bring the Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer.

attribution: In-game quest text: Battle of Warsong Gulch
